text:
mara: Heads-up — planning a prod rollout for release/2026-03-17 in ~10m. Canary at 10% for 15m. @devin @sam @jen please ack who will run smoke and who is rollback standby. I'll coordinate handoff.

jen: Ack. I'm doing the deploy. Starting canary push in ~5m and will run smoke script + tail logs. Ping me for immediate roll commands. Smoke command I'll run:
```bash
./eng-releases/run_smoke.sh --env=prod --canary
```

devin: I'm on metrics & rollback standby. Watch p95 latency, 5xx rate, and model token errors. Rollback triggers: 5xx > 0.5% sustained for 3m OR p95 increases +200ms sustained. Hotfix/rollback branch ready: `git checkout -b rollback/prod && ./deploy rollback --tag=release/2026-03-16`

sam: I'll monitor dashboards: /console/dashboards/prod-latency, /console/dashboards/prod-errors, /console/dashboards/cost-per-token. Will post short updates every 5m. If I see a spike I'll @devin and @mara. :mag:

deploy-bot: canary deployment started: release/2026-03-17 -> prod (10% traffic). Tracking id: dpl_1798123456_canary

k8s-bot: scaled replicaSet rs-release-2026-03-17 to 12 pods across clusters us-west1/us-east1

jen: Canary is up, smoke script running. Quick smoke results: token-gen OK, embeddings service responding. P95 latency +35ms vs baseline. No 5xx observed so far. Logs tail snippet:
```text
[INFO] 00:00:10 token gen ok
[WARN] 00:00:12 redis latency 45ms
```
:thumbsup:

sam: Metrics @5m: global 5xx=0.12% (baseline 0.08%), p95 +40ms (within acceptable). cost/token unchanged. continuing watch.

devin: noted. thresholds still within. Preparing rollback steps, but won't trigger unless thresholds hit. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: canary health checks: 200/200 checks passed. Promoting to 50% in 2m.

jen: Promoting now to 50%. I'll keep logs open and run an extra integration smoke against the reranking endpoint.

sam: At 50% -> seeing a localized spike of 502s in us-east1, ~0.6% in that region, global 5xx=0.35%. @jen do you want me to cut region or do partial rollback?

jen: I see the us-east1 errors. Doing a partial rollback for us-east1 nodes to the previous replica set to isolate. Initiating now. :wrench:

deploy-bot: rollback step initiated for rs-release-2026-03-17 us-east1 nodes (5 pods).

sam: After partial rollback, us-east1 5xx dropped to 0.08%. Global 5xx back to 0.12%. p95 normalized. Good call.

mara: Nice work. Jen — please open a follow-up PR for the node-level kernel/mismatch hypothesis and add remediation steps. I'll mark deploy as successful but with follow-ups: postmortem note + smoke artifact.

jen: Will open PR #2345 and attach smoke logs and kube events. Also scheduling a kube drain + recreate for the affected nodes tomorrow. :memo:

devin: I left the rollback commands and verification notes in the runbook under 'prod-rollbacks' with exact commands used.

mara: Closing thread — leave any follow-ups here. Great coordination, everyone. :tada:
